_about: Hand-picked Originalist's Corner passages from the library's full texts, merged into docs/data/corner.js by scripts/corner_curated.py (run after build_corner.pl). Each passage is taken from the library text at book/part/block (or from an Internet Archive OCR file), optionally cut to the span from..to; 'fix' lists OCR misreadings corrected against the printed page ([misread, printed]).

spirit-of-laws.name: Montesquieu, The Spirit of Laws
spirit-of-laws.author: Montesquieu
spirit-of-laws.desc: The comparative study of laws and governments behind the founders' separation of powers.

notes-virginia.name: Jefferson, Notes on the State of Virginia
notes-virginia.author: Thomas Jefferson
notes-virginia.desc: Jefferson's account of Virginia, with his critique of its 1776 constitution.

thoughts-government.name: Adams, Thoughts on Government
thoughts-government.author: John Adams
thoughts-government.desc: Adams's plan for republican state constitutions.

farrand-1-2.name: Farrand, The Records of the Federal Convention (vols. I–II)
farrand-1-2.author: Max Farrand (ed.)
farrand-1-2.desc: The Convention's daily records: the Journal with Madison's, Yates's, King's and others' notes.

elliot-debates.name: Elliot's Debates: The State Ratifying Conventions
elliot-debates.author: Jonathan Elliot (ed.)
elliot-debates.desc: The debates in the state conventions that ratified the Constitution.

annals-1.name: Annals of Congress, First Congress
annals-1.author: Joseph Gales (comp.)
annals-1.desc: The First Congress's debates, including the Bill of Rights and the removal power.

state-papers.name: State Papers of the Early Republic
state-papers.author: Congress, Jefferson, Madison
state-papers.desc: The amendments of 1789, the Kentucky Resolutions of 1799 and Madison's Report of 1800.

ford-pamphlets.name: Ford, Pamphlets on the Constitution
ford-pamphlets.author: Paul Leicester Ford (ed.)
ford-pamphlets.desc: Ratification pamphlets for and against the Constitution.

novanglus.name: Adams, Novanglus, with the Letters to William Tudor
novanglus.author: John Adams
novanglus.desc: Adams's newspaper debate with Daniel Leonard, and his later letters on the Revolution's origins.

mckechnie-magna-carta.name: McKechnie, Magna Carta: A Commentary
mckechnie-magna-carta.author: William Sharp McKechnie
mckechnie-magna-carta.desc: A clause-by-clause commentary on the Great Charter.

tocqueville.name: Tocqueville, Democracy in America
tocqueville.author: Alexis de Tocqueville
tocqueville.desc: Tocqueville's account of American democracy, its laws and its manners.

hume-political.name: Hume, Political Discourses
hume-political.author: David Hume
hume-political.desc: Hume's essays on commerce, population, parties and government, read closely by Madison.

wilson-lectures.name: Wilson, Lectures on Law
wilson-lectures.author: James Wilson
wilson-lectures.desc: The lectures on law that Justice Wilson gave in Philadelphia in 1790–1791.
